title: Butter bean and leek hotpot
summary: Butter bean and leek hotpot is a british dinner built around canned butter beans and parsnips, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Butter bean and leek hotpot into even pieces and toss parsnips with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of parsnips while you season canned butter beans. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle canned butter beans and leeks among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Butter bean and leek hotpot before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Butter bean and leek hotpot into warm bowls with the juices.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
